Class PauseMenuRenderer

java.lang.Object
com.cuseto.pong.view.PauseMenuRenderer
public final class PauseMenuRenderer extends Object
Builds the pause menu overlay: a "Match Paused" panel with resume and quit buttons, dimmed over the gameplay behind it.

This class only builds the overlay's node tree and lets callers wire up its buttons; it does not add or remove itself from a scene. GamePageRenderer owns showing and hiding root() in the gameplay scene.
